name: audit-log-01
title: Audit Log 01 - An Append Only Record Of What Changed
description: A record of what changed, where the moment, the actor, the target and the change are four separate props and the sixth column shows a before and an after through the Diff component, because Diff already states that it emphasises by weight rather than by colour since it is leaning on the two hues a reader is most likely to be unable to distinguish. A tone needs a caller supplied label whenever it is used and the run throws otherwise, and the order is the caller own because an audit trail that a Block reordered would be a claim about which record came first, and that claim is the record.
